data.summary: services/gates/baseline_red.py compares failing test ids with the base and nothing else. A ratchet test that is already red on main hides a regression the branch adds to it. Seen on fix-B-main-red-grok-harness-row: ci recorded tests/test_no_agent_literals.py::test_no_new_agent_literal as baseline-red, while the branch itself added a site (ddflow/mcpshim/clients.py 31 found, 30 allowed) that main does not have. Only a direct run of the test showed it. Once the base goes green the branch would have turned it red again.
data.title: ci baseline-red matches test ids only, so a new cause in an already red test reads as baseline

Fixes bug B-baseline-red-hides-new-cause: services/gates/baseline_red.py compares failing test ids with the base and nothing else. A ratchet test that is already red on main hides a regression the branch adds to it. Only a direct run of the test showed it. Once the base goes green the branch would have turned it red again. Found on fix-B-main-red-grok-harness-row.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-baseline-red-hides-new-cause --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-baseline-red-hides-new-cause --regression-test <test>` first).
